title: Tractor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="42" ry="6" fill="#2a2a4a"/>

  <!-- Rear wheel (large) -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="16" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="13" fill="#555555"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="7" fill="#888888"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="3" fill="#cccccc"/>
  <!-- Tread marks -->
  <rect x="63" y="63" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#777777" transform="rotate(0 68 78)"/>
  <rect x="78" y="73" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#777777"/>
  <rect x="73" y="88" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#777777"/>
  <rect x="58" y="83" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#777777"/>
  <rect x="53" y="73" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#777777"/>
  <rect x="63" y="88" width="4" height="5" rx="1" fill="#777777"/>

  <!-- Front wheel (small) -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="82" r="10" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="82" r="8" fill="#555555"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="82" r="4" fill="#888888"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="82" r="2" fill="#cccccc"/>

  <!-- Tractor body -->
  <rect x="18" y="52" width="52" height="24" rx="4" fill="#e63946"/>
  <rect x="18" y="52" width="52" height="6" rx="3" fill="#f4707a"/>

  <!-- Cab / cabin -->
  <rect x="42" y="26" width="26" height="28" rx="4" fill="#e63946"/>
  <rect x="42" y="26" width="26" height="6" rx="3" fill="#f4707a"/>
  <!-- Cabin window -->
  <rect x="46" y="32" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <rect x="46" y="32" width="18" height="4" rx="2" fill="#a8ddf0"/>

  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="36" y="20" width="5" height="14" rx="1" fill="#777777"/>
  <rect x="34" y="17" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#999999"/>

  <!-- Engine hood -->
  <rect x="18" y="44" width="26" height="10" rx="3" fill="#d62839"/>
  <rect x="18" y="44" width="26" height="3" rx="2" fill="#f4707a"/>

  <!-- Grille details -->
  <rect x="20" y="46" width="22" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffb4b4"/>
  <rect x="20" y="49" width="22" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffb4b4"/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="58" r="3" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#fff3b0"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on the cab/body -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="42" r="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="41" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="41" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M50 48 Q57 55 64 48" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="47" r="2.5" fill="#ff9999" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="47" r="2.5" fill="#ff9999" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d="M50 68 Q52 60 68 60 Q84 60 86 68" stroke="#d62839" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Steering wheel hint inside window -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="39" r="2" fill="#555577" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
